title: fix(metadata-protocol): a position saved active through the meta save door carries its renamed holders at once
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbKnsd8ZLsq9hBbRRm5JvJb2)_
Fixes #33788

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:通过元数据保存入口直接保存为 active 的岗位(position),现在会像逐项发布那样通知宿主,宿主随即广播 `metadata:reloaded`(`position/NAME`),改名岗位的持有人当场随迁。
- **为什么改**:以前只有"草稿 + 发布"会广播;直接保存为 active 时什么都不广播,`renamedFrom` 的持有人迁移要等到重启,期间持有人挂在已不存在的旧岗位名上,失去该岗位的权限。
- **风险与回滚**:只对 position 类型生效;逐项发布与批量发布不经过这条保存路径,不会重复广播;复制包、非托管导入这两个批量入口按写入面排除,不会每个岗位广播一次。每次 active 保存岗位多一次全量重同步(与发布一个岗位的代价相同)。回滚即还原 `protocol-save.ts` 里这一个分支。
- **先看**:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts`(新增的 position 分支,在投影器与变更事件之后、await 通知)→ `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-active-save-position-carry.test.ts`(真实组合的端到端钉子)→ `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.publish-item-rebind-announce.test.ts`(新 describe)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-active-save-position-carry.test.ts`,预期 3 个用例全绿;在 main 上首个用例红(持有人仍是旧岗位名)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `saveMetaItem` in its default (active) mode, for the type `position` only, now awaits `host.emitMetaItemPublished({ type, name, organizationId: null })` right after the save's projector and its mutation event — the same signal, at the same point relative to the side effects, that the per-item publish door emits. `ObjectQLPlugin` (unchanged) turns it into `metadata:reloaded` with `changed: ['position/NAME']`, which plugin-security's `renamedFrom` holder carry (`positionRenameReloadScope`) reads. Awaited, so the door's 2xx means the holders were carried, not merely queued; the published signal never rides the cluster channel, so only the node that took the save announces.
- Position only, by ruling 6899911103 (option B): the types with a live consumer of a direct active save (flow, connector, permission, translation) already hear the mutation event, and announcing every type would cost a kernel-wide re-sync per active save and per item of every internal caller of the save door.
- The per-item publish and `POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts` never pass through the save door, so neither announces twice (measured below).
- **Correction to report 6899866511 and to the ruling's restore/revert line.** I wrote there that the restore and revert doors save a position through `saveMetaItem`; read again, they do not: `revertCommit` and `rollbackMetaItem` emit the mutation event directly and never call the save door, so **they announce nothing new** and a restored or reverted renamed position is still carried at the next restart, as before. The internal callers that DO save a position through `saveMetaItem` are the two bulk package doors, `duplicatePackage` (write face `package-duplicate`) and the unmanaged package import (`package-unmanaged-import`), plus the two maintenance migrations (the packageless-overlay migration and `os migrate` organization ownership).
- **Bulk-door guard (narrower than the ruling's letter, inside its intent).** The two bulk package doors save every copied item through the save door, so the bare position branch would have announced once per copied position — one kernel-wide re-sync per position inside one operation, the announce storm the dispatch asked to avoid. Their server-stated write faces skip the signal; what those doors carry stays as it was (the next restart). The two migrations, rare and operator-run, announce per re-saved position.
- The `MetaItemPublishedEvent` docblock (`protocol-mutation-events.ts`) names the active position save as the one other emitter.
- Changeset: `patch` for `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`.

## Tests

Readings at head `6765f182ff` (= origin/main `86350e125d` merged + this diff) unless named otherwise, under the shared verify lock.

- New real-composition pin `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-active-save-position-carry.test.ts` (ObjectKernel + SQL driver on better-sqlite3 in memory + `ObjectQLPlugin` + the real `SecurityPlugin` + the `HttpDispatcher` meta door; the recorder only listens): the active save carries the holder before the door answers and announces at most once; CONTROL the draft save + per-item publish announces exactly once; CONTROL publish-drafts of two positions announces exactly once for the batch.
- New top-level describe in the shared harness `protocol.publish-item-rebind-announce.test.ts` (ruling 6583487846): an active position save emits once and is awaited; the plural spelling folds to `position`; a draft save emits nothing and its per-item publish emits exactly once; CONTROL publish-drafts emits nothing per item; the two bulk write faces emit nothing per position; CONTROL an active save of a flow emits nothing.

## Acceptance notes

- Measured before choosing (report 6899866511): announcing from `ObjectQLPlugin`'s mutation listener instead double-announces every per-item position publish and adds one re-sync per position on publish-drafts; a plugin-security mutation listener carries without an announce but answers before the move and runs the carry on every replica. Both were prototyped, measured and discarded.
- Noted, not filed (no reach): restored or reverted renamed positions are still carried at the next restart (the restore doors emit only the mutation event); the unmanaged package import announces nothing after it lands (read, not measured). Also the `HttpDispatcher` meta door answers 404 for the per-item publish path and 405 for DELETE, which the REST server serves; seen only as harness setup. Whether other types' active saves leave a boot-cached `metadata:reloaded` consumer stale is unmeasured.
- `test:repo` not run locally (owned by CI's Test Core); the diff touches no file of that project.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `6765f182ff` (5 paths vs merge base `86350e125`): 69 families, each run locally at `6765f182ff`, every one exit 0 (exit captured before any pipe); `--ran` reconciliation: "69 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
